text: Air Europa is the airline of Grupo Globalia, the Spanish tourism group founded by Juan Jose Hidalgo; the legal entity behind the brand is Air Europa Lineas Aereas, S.A.U.
short: Air Europa is the airline of Grupo Globalia

source.name: Globalia: Air Europa (corporate site)
source.quote: Air Europa es la aerolínea del Grupo Globalia.
source.note: globalia.com serves a JavaScript app; the page text was read through a reader proxy and the quote is on the rendered page.
